race.description: Happy Retirement Adam Carney Mdn Plate
race.comment: STATEROOM (10) kept chasing on debut in the soft (7) going with a gritty third over 1200m at Canterbury. Looking for the extra ground now and finds a much easier contest despite drawing out. Hard to hold out. SPARKLING FIRE (1) has finished runner-up in his two race starts and shapes as the main danger second up. Eased in betting on resumption with a narrow on-pace second over 1200m at Newcastle from the rails draw. Should handle the going and figure prominently. KIVISKA (9) Proisir three-year-old gelding out of Zanyetta on debut for the Waller yard. Wasn't knocked about in his last two trials and look for him closing late. TAHURANGI (7) drifted back further than anticipated on resumption with a battling sixth over 1200m at Gosford. Expected to race closer with a clean getaway. Each way.
